summary: Plan written: add a first-class merge_state 'blocked' (plugin reads mergeable_state), route it to needs_human_merge in auto-merge (robust backstop) and to an owner escalation in the poller (front line); no doomed merge, no rework, bounded by leaving the poll set. Includes ordered steps + per-part verification and regression tests.

details.approach: Approach A — first-class 'blocked' contract value handled at the two Core merge-readiness decision points; rejected a re-entry counter (Approach B) and promote-through-auto-merge (Approach C).

verification.note: node_modules not installed in this worktree — pnpm install is Step 0.

decisions.summary: Change spans plugin + adapter contract + two Core files + a bundled doc string + three test files, beyond the single 'core' file.
decisions.chosen: Touch all listed files in one PR to deliver the fix completely (plugin detection + Core policy + doc sync + regression tests).
decisions.reasoning: The fix is inherently cross-layer (host-truth in the plugin, wait/escalate policy in Core) as the issue itself mandates; splitting it would ship a partial, unsafe change. No broad refactor, dependency, public-API, destructive, or security change is involved.
